reader: Claude Opus 5.5, research reader with source
reason: The first reading had single words of each cut line; with the edition the lines could be placed, their abbreviations expanded and the two pieces joined.
sources: Aegidius de Fuscarariis, Ordo iudiciarius, ed. L. Wahrmund, Quellen zur Geschichte des roemisch-kanonischen Processes im Mittelalter III.1 (Innsbruck 1916), cc. LXIX-LXX, pp. 124-126, page images at https://archive.org/details/p1p2quellenzurge03wahr (leaves 176-178)
Wahrmund, introduction to the same volume, for the attribution and the date after 1262 (read in the scan's machine-read text)
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-a07w (Antwerpen, Erfgoedbibliotheek Hendrik Conscience, Fragm. 140 a-b). All lines of the four faces were reread by a research reader on 2x enlargements of the images with Wahrmund's edition of Aegidius de Fuscarariis, Ordo iudiciarius, cc. LXIX-LXX (pp. 124-126) at hand; the lines below are those relied on. Lines 1-8 of each face of strip A are rubbed and lean on the edition. [ = text lost at the cut; (...) = expansion; (?) = uncertain.
